event_time_policy: All event time values are synthetic source_record_event_time assertions with explicit synthetic time_evidence_ref attributes. Production export must not use these placeholders.
money_policy: Amounts are integer minor units under explicit SAP-NOTE-V1; no floating point or implied FX conversion.
causal_policy: Event-event causal references are not encoded as OCEL relationships; see the separate owner-scoped causal sidecar.
strictness: No nonstandard metadata is added to the OCEL document root. This metadata is maintained separately.
